passages.text: Now the two angels arrived at Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting in the gateway of the city. When Lot saw them, he got up to meet them, bowed facedown, and said, “My lords, please turn aside into the house of your servant; wash your feet and spend the night. Then you can rise early and go on your way.” “No,” they answered, “we will spend the night in the square.”
passages.sermon:
Two angels came to Sodom in the evening.
Lot was sitting at the city gate.
Lot saw the two angels.
He got up to meet them.
He bowed down with his face to the ground.
Lot spoke to the angels.
He said, “My lords, please come to your servant’s house.
Spend the night here.
Wash your feet.
In the morning, you can get up and go on your way.”
The angels replied, “No.
We will spend the night in the city square.”
passages.original: וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ שְׁנֵ֨י הַמַּלְאָכִ֤ים סְדֹ֙מָה֙ בָּעֶ֔רֶב וְל֖וֹט יֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּשַֽׁעַר־ סְדֹ֑ם וַיַּרְא־ לוֹט֙ וַיָּ֣קָם לִקְרָאתָ֔ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ אַפַּ֖יִם אָֽרְצָה׃ וַיֹּ֜אמֶר הִנֶּ֣ה נָּא־ אֲדֹנַ֗י ס֣וּרוּ נָ֠א אֶל־ בֵּ֨ית עַבְדְּכֶ֤ם וְלִ֙ינוּ֙ וְרַחֲצ֣וּ רַגְלֵיכֶ֔ם וְהִשְׁכַּמְתֶּ֖ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֣ם לְדַרְכְּכֶ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לֹּ֔א כִּ֥י בָרְח֖וֹב נָלִֽין׃

passages.text: But Lot insisted so strongly that they followed him into his house. He prepared a feast for them and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.
passages.sermon:
Lot saw two angels arrive at Sodom in the evening.
Lot sat at the city gate.
Lot met the angels.
Lot invited them to his house.
The angels first refused.
Lot insisted very strongly.
The angels agreed to go with Lot.
The angels entered Lot’s house.
Lot prepared a feast for them.
Lot baked unleavened bread for them.
The angels ate the food.
passages.original: וַיִּפְצַר־ בָּ֣ם מְאֹ֔ד וַיָּסֻ֣רוּ אֵלָ֔יו וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־ בֵּית֑וֹ וַיַּ֤עַשׂ לָהֶם֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה וּמַצּ֥וֹת אָפָ֖ה וַיֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃

passages.text: Before they had gone to bed, all the men of the city of Sodom, both young and old, surrounded the house.
passages.sermon:
The men of Sodom lived in the city of Sodom.
These men came from every part of the city.
Some of these men were young.
Some of these men were old.
All these men gathered together.
They surrounded Lot’s house.
This happened before Lot and his guests went to bed.
passages.original: טֶרֶם֮ יִשְׁכָּבוּ֒ וְאַנְשֵׁ֨י הָעִ֜יר אַנְשֵׁ֤י סְדֹם֙ נָסַ֣בּוּ עַל־ הַבַּ֔יִת מִנַּ֖עַר וְעַד־ זָקֵ֑ן כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם מִקָּצֶֽה׃

passages.text: They called out to Lot, saying, “Where are the men who came to you tonight? Send them out to us so we can have relations with them!”
passages.sermon:
The men of Sodom gathered around Lot’s house.
They called out to Lot.
They spoke to him directly.
They said, “Where are the men who came to you tonight?”
They demanded Lot to bring the men out to them.
They said they wanted to have relations with the men.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרְא֤וּ אֶל־ לוֹט֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֔וֹ אַיֵּ֧ה הָאֲנָשִׁ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥אוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַלָּ֑יְלָה הוֹצִיאֵ֣ם אֵלֵ֔ינוּ וְנֵדְעָ֖ה אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Lot went outside to meet them, shutting the door behind him.
passages.sermon:
Lot lived in Sodom.
Lot saw the men of the city surround his house.
Lot went outside to meet the men.
Lot shut the door behind him.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֧א אֲלֵהֶ֛ם ל֖וֹט הַפֶּ֑תְחָה וְהַדֶּ֖לֶת סָגַ֥ר אַחֲרָֽיו׃

passages.text: “Please, my brothers,” he pleaded, “don’t do such a wicked thing!
passages.sermon: Lot spoke to the men of Sodom.\r\nHe said, “Please, my brothers.\r\nDo not do this evil thing.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אַל־ נָ֥א אַחַ֖י תָּרֵֽעוּ׃

passages.text: Look, I have two daughters who have never slept with a man. Let me bring them to you, and you can do to them as you please. But do not do anything to these men, for they have come under the protection of my roof.”
passages.sermon:
Lot was a resident of Sodom.
Lot spoke to the men outside his house.
Lot said, “Look, I have two daughters.
My daughters have never slept with a man.
Let me bring my daughters out to you.
You may do to them as you please.
But do not do anything to these men.
These men have come under the protection of my roof.”
passages.original: הִנֵּה־ נָ֨א לִ֜י שְׁתֵּ֣י בָנ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ יָדְעוּ֙ אִ֔ישׁ אוֹצִֽיאָה־ נָּ֤א אֶתְהֶן֙ אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וַעֲשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֔ן כַּטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם רַ֠ק לָֽאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָאֵל֙ אַל־ תַּעֲשׂ֣וּ דָבָ֔ר כִּֽי־ עַל־ כֵּ֥ן בָּ֖אוּ בְּצֵ֥ל קֹרָתִֽי׃

passages.text: “Get out of the way!” they replied. And they declared, “This one came here as a foreigner, and he is already acting like a judge! Now we will treat you worse than them.” And they pressed in on Lot and moved in to break down the door.
passages.sermon:
A crowd of men surrounded Lot’s house in Sodom.
They spoke to Lot.
They said, “Get out of the way.”
They said, “This man came here as a foreigner.”
They said, “Now he acts like a judge.”
They said, “We will treat you worse than them.”
They pressed hard against Lot.
They moved forward to break down the door.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ׀ גֶּשׁ־ הָ֗לְאָה וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ הָאֶחָ֤ד בָּֽא־ לָגוּר֙ וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֣ט שָׁפ֔וֹט עַתָּ֕ה נָרַ֥ע לְךָ֖ מֵהֶ֑ם וַיִּפְצְר֨וּ בָאִ֤ישׁ בְּלוֹט֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַֽיִּגְּשׁ֖וּ לִשְׁבֹּ֥ר הַדָּֽלֶת׃

passages.text: But the men inside reached out, pulled Lot into the house with them, and shut the door.
passages.sermon:
Two men were inside Lot’s house.
These men were actually angels.
They saw Lot in danger outside.
The men reached out their hands.
They pulled Lot into the house with them.
They shut the door behind Lot.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלְח֤וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֶת־ יָדָ֔ם וַיָּבִ֧יאוּ אֶת־ ל֛וֹט אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הַבָּ֑יְתָה וְאֶת־ הַדֶּ֖לֶת סָגָֽרוּ׃

passages.text: And they struck the men at the entrance, young and old, with blindness, so that they wearied themselves trying to find the door.
passages.sermon:
Two angels stood inside Lot’s house.
They acted to protect Lot from the crowd outside.
The angels struck the men at the entrance of the house with blindness.
They struck all the men, both young and old.
The men outside could not see.
They tried to find the door.
They became tired as they searched for the entrance.
passages.original: וְֽאֶת־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֞ים אֲשֶׁר־ פֶּ֣תַח הַבַּ֗יִת הִכּוּ֙ בַּסַּנְוֵרִ֔ים מִקָּטֹ֖ן וְעַד־ גָּד֑וֹל וַיִּלְא֖וּ לִמְצֹ֥א הַפָּֽתַח׃

passages.text: Then the two men said to Lot, “Do you have anyone else here—a son-in-law, your sons or daughters, or anyone else in the city who belongs to you? Get them out of here, because we are about to destroy this place. For the outcry to the LORD against its people is so great that He has sent us to destroy it.”
passages.sermon:
Two angels spoke to Lot.
They said, “Do you have anyone else here?”
They asked, “Do you have a son-in-law?”
They asked, “Do you have sons?”
They asked, “Do you have daughters?”
They said, “Do you have anyone else in the city who belongs to you?”
They said, “Take them out of this place.”
They said, “We will destroy this place.”
They said, “The outcry against this city is very great before the LORD.”
They said, “The LORD has sent us to destroy it.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים אֶל־ ל֗וֹט עֹ֚ד מִֽי־ לְךָ֣ פֹ֔ה חָתָן֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יךָ וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ לְךָ֖ בָּעִ֑יר הוֹצֵ֖א מִן־ הַמָּקֽוֹם׃ כִּֽי־ מַשְׁחִתִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ אֶת־ הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּֽי־ גָֽדְלָ֤ה צַעֲקָתָם֙ אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיְשַׁלְּחֵ֥נוּ יְהוָ֖ה לְשַׁחֲתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: So Lot went out and spoke to the sons-in-law who were pledged in marriage to his daughters. “Get up,” he said. “Get out of this place, for the LORD is about to destroy the city!” But his sons-in-law thought he was joking.
passages.sermon:
Lot was a righteous man living in Sodom.
Two angels warned Lot that God would destroy the city.
Lot went out to his sons-in-law.
These men were pledged to marry his daughters.
Lot spoke to them.
He said, “Get up.
Leave this place.
The LORD will destroy the city.”
His sons-in-law thought Lot was joking.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א ל֜וֹט וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר׀ אֶל־ חֲתָנָ֣יו׀ לֹקְחֵ֣י בְנֹתָ֗יו וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ ק֤וּמוּ צְּאוּ֙ מִן־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה כִּֽי־ מַשְׁחִ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ הָעִ֑יר וַיְהִ֥י כִמְצַחֵ֖ק בְּעֵינֵ֥י חֲתָנָֽיו׃

passages.text: At daybreak the angels hurried Lot along, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away in the punishment of the city.”
passages.sermon:
Lot lived in the city of Sodom.
God sent two angels to warn Lot.
At daybreak, the angels spoke to Lot.
The angels hurried Lot.
They said, “Get up!”
They said, “Take your wife.”
They said, “Take your two daughters who are here.”
They warned Lot.
They said, “If you do not leave, you will be swept away.”
They said, “The city will be punished for its sin.”
passages.original: וּכְמוֹ֙ הַשַּׁ֣חַר עָלָ֔ה וַיָּאִ֥יצוּ הַמַּלְאָכִ֖ים בְּל֣וֹט לֵאמֹ֑ר קוּם֩ קַ֨ח אֶֽת־ אִשְׁתְּךָ֜ וְאֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֤י בְנֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ הַנִּמְצָאֹ֔ת פֶּן־ תִּסָּפֶ֖ה בַּעֲוֺ֥ן הָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: But when Lot hesitated, the men grabbed his hand and the hands of his wife and his two daughters. And they led them safely out of the city, because of the LORD’s compassion for them.
passages.sermon:
Lot was a righteous man living in Sodom.
God decided to destroy the city because of its wickedness.
Lot hesitated to leave.
Two angels were with Lot.
The angels took hold of Lot’s hand.
They also took the hand of Lot’s wife.
They took the hands of Lot’s two daughters.
The LORD showed compassion to Lot and his family.
The angels led Lot and his family out of the city.
They brought them to safety outside the city.
passages.original: וַֽיִּתְמַהְמָ֓הּ׀ וַיַּחֲזִ֨קוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים בְּיָד֣וֹ וּבְיַד־ אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ וּבְיַד֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י בְנֹתָ֔יו בְּחֶמְלַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה עָלָ֑יו וַיֹּצִאֻ֥הוּ וַיַּנִּחֻ֖הוּ מִח֥וּץ לָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: As soon as the men had brought them out, one of them said, “Run for your lives! Do not look back, and do not stop anywhere on the plain! Flee to the mountains, or you will be swept away!”
passages.sermon:
The men brought Lot, his wife, and his two daughters outside the city.
One of the men spoke to them.
He said, "Run for your lives."
He said, "Do not look back."
He said, "Do not stop anywhere on the plain."
He said, "Flee to the mountains."
He said, "If you do not flee, you will be swept away."
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ כְהוֹצִיאָ֨ם אֹתָ֜ם הַח֗וּצָה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הִמָּלֵ֣ט עַל־ נַפְשֶׁ֔ךָ אַל־ תַּבִּ֣יט אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ וְאַֽל־ תַּעֲמֹ֖ד בְּכָל־ הַכִּכָּ֑ר הָהָ֥רָה הִמָּלֵ֖ט פֶּן־ תִּסָּפֶֽה׃

passages.text: But Lot replied, “No, my lords, please!
passages.sermon: Lot spoke to the men.\r\nLot said, “No, my lords, please!”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹט אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אַל־ נָ֖א אֲדֹנָֽי׃

passages.text: Your servant has indeed found favor in your sight, and you have shown me great kindness by sparing my life. But I cannot run to the mountains; the disaster will overtake me, and I will die.
passages.sermon:
Lot spoke to the angels who were saving him from Sodom.
Lot was a servant who needed help.
Lot said, “I have found favor in your sight.”
Lot said, “You have shown me great kindness.”
Lot said, “You have saved my life.”
Lot said, “I cannot escape to the mountains.”
Lot said, “If I try, disaster will reach me.”
Lot said, “If disaster reaches me, I will die.”
passages.original: הִנֵּה־ נָ֠א מָצָ֨א עַבְדְּךָ֣ חֵן֮ בְּעֵינֶיךָ֒ וַתַּגְדֵּ֣ל חַסְדְּךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ עִמָּדִ֔י לְהַחֲי֖וֹת אֶת־ נַפְשִׁ֑י וְאָנֹכִ֗י לֹ֤א אוּכַל֙ לְהִמָּלֵ֣ט הָהָ֔רָה פֶּן־ תִּדְבָּקַ֥נִי הָרָעָ֖ה וָמַֽתִּי׃

passages.text: Look, there is a town nearby where I can flee, and it is a small place. Please let me flee there—is it not a small place? Then my life will be saved.”
passages.sermon:
Lot spoke to the angels who were saving him from Sodom.
Lot said, “Look, there is a town nearby.
I can run to that town.
The town is small.
Please let me escape to that town.
It is a small place.
If I go there, my life will be saved.”
passages.original: הִנֵּה־ נָ֠א הָעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֧את קְרֹבָ֛ה לָנ֥וּס שָׁ֖מָּה וְהִ֣יא מִצְעָ֑ר אִמָּלְטָ֨ה נָּ֜א שָׁ֗מָּה הֲלֹ֥א מִצְעָ֛ר הִ֖וא וּתְחִ֥י נַפְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: “Very well,” he answered, “I will grant this request as well, and will not demolish the town you indicate.
passages.sermon:
An angel spoke to Lot.
The angel said, “I have listened to you about this matter.
I will not destroy the town you mentioned.
I will spare that town as you requested.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו הִנֵּה֙ נָשָׂ֣אתִי פָנֶ֔יךָ גַּ֖ם לַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה לְבִלְתִּ֛י הָפְכִּ֥י אֶת־ הָעִ֖יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ׃

passages.text: Hurry! Run there quickly, for I cannot do anything until you reach it.” That is why the town was called Zoar.
passages.sermon:
An angel spoke to Lot.
The angel told Lot to hurry.
The angel said, “Run quickly to that town.”
The angel explained, “I cannot do anything until you arrive there.”
The town was called Zoar for this reason.
passages.original: מַהֵר֙ הִמָּלֵ֣ט שָׁ֔מָּה כִּ֣י לֹ֤א אוּכַל֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת דָּבָ֔ר עַד־ בֹּאֲךָ֖ שָׁ֑מָּה עַל־ כֵּ֛ן קָרָ֥א שֵׁם־ הָעִ֖יר צֽוֹעַר׃

passages.text: And by the time the sun had risen over the land, Lot had reached Zoar.
passages.sermon: Lot was a man fleeing from Sodom.\r\nThe sun rose over the land.\r\nLot arrived in Zoar.
passages.original: הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ יָצָ֣א עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְל֖וֹט בָּ֥א צֹֽעֲרָה׃

passages.text: Then the LORD rained down sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah—from the LORD out of the heavens.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD sent sulfur and fire.
The LORD sent this on Sodom and Gomorrah.
The LORD sent it from the heavens.
passages.original: וַֽיהוָ֗ה הִמְטִ֧יר עַל־ סְדֹ֛ם וְעַל־ עֲמֹרָ֖ה גָּפְרִ֣ית וָאֵ֑שׁ מֵאֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה מִן־ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Thus He destroyed these cities and the entire plain, including all the inhabitants of the cities and everything that grew on the ground.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acted with power.
He destroyed these cities.
He destroyed the entire plain.
He destroyed all the people who lived in the cities.
He destroyed everything that grew on the ground.
passages.original: וַֽיַּהֲפֹךְ֙ אֶת־ הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔ל וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ הַכִּכָּ֑ר וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הֶעָרִ֔ים וְצֶ֖מַח הָאֲדָמָֽה׃

passages.text: But Lot’s wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.
passages.sermon:
Lot was a man who lived in Sodom.
God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah with fire and sulfur from heaven.
Lot and his family fled from the city.
Lot’s wife looked back as they escaped.
She became a pillar of salt.
passages.original: וַתַּבֵּ֥ט אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מֵאַחֲרָ֑יו וַתְּהִ֖י נְצִ֥יב מֶֽלַח׃

passages.text: Early the next morning, Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Abraham was a servant of God.
He woke up early in the morning.
He went back to the place.
This was the place where he had stood before the LORD.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֥ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם בַּבֹּ֑קֶר אֶל־ הַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ עָ֥מַד שָׁ֖ם אֶת־ פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah and all the land of the plain, and he saw the smoke rising from the land like smoke from a furnace.
passages.sermon:
Abraham stood in the place where he had met the LORD.
Abraham looked down toward Sodom.
He looked toward Gomorrah.
He looked over all the land of the plain.
He saw the land.
He saw smoke rising from the land.
The smoke rose like smoke from a furnace.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁקֵ֗ף עַל־ פְּנֵ֤י סְדֹם֙ וַעֲמֹרָ֔ה וְעַֽל־ כָּל־ פְּנֵ֖י אֶ֣רֶץ הַכִּכָּ֑ר וַיַּ֗רְא וְהִנֵּ֤ה עָלָה֙ קִיטֹ֣ר הָאָ֔רֶץ כְּקִיטֹ֖ר הַכִּבְשָֽׁן׃

passages.text: So when God destroyed the cities of the plain, He remembered Abraham, and He brought Lot out of the catastrophe that destroyed the cities where he had lived.
passages.sermon:
God destroyed the cities of the plain.
God remembered Abraham.
God brought Lot out of the disaster.
Lot had lived in those cities.
The disaster destroyed those cities.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּשַׁחֵ֤ת אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ עָרֵ֣י הַכִּכָּ֔ר וַיִּזְכֹּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיְשַׁלַּ֤ח אֶת־ לוֹט֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַהֲפֵכָ֔ה בַּהֲפֹךְ֙ אֶת־ הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ יָשַׁ֥ב בָּהֵ֖ן לֽוֹט׃

passages.text: Lot and his two daughters left Zoar and settled in the mountains—for he was afraid to stay in Zoar—where they lived in a cave.
passages.sermon:
Lot was a man who survived the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.
God saved Lot because God remembered Abraham.
Lot had two daughters.
Lot and his two daughters left the city of Zoar.
Lot was afraid to stay in Zoar.
Lot and his two daughters went to live in the mountains.
Lot and his two daughters lived in a cave in the mountains.
passages.original: וַיַּעַל֩ ל֨וֹט מִצּ֜וֹעַר וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב בָּהָ֗ר וּשְׁתֵּ֤י בְנֹתָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י יָרֵ֖א לָשֶׁ֣בֶת בְּצ֑וֹעַר וַיֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ בַּמְּעָרָ֔ה ה֖וּא וּשְׁתֵּ֥י בְנֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: One day the older daughter said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is no man in the land to sleep with us, as is the custom over all the earth.
passages.sermon:
Lot was the father of the two daughters.
The older daughter spoke to the younger daughter.
She said, "Our father is old."
She said, "There is no man in this land."
She said, "No man can come to us."
She said, "This is not like the way of all the earth."
She meant that no man was here to marry them or have children with them, as was usual everywhere else.
passages.original: וַתֹּ֧אמֶר הַבְּכִירָ֛ה אֶל־ הַצְּעִירָ֖ה אָבִ֣ינוּ זָקֵ֑ן וְאִ֨ישׁ אֵ֤ין בָּאָ֙רֶץ֙ לָב֣וֹא עָלֵ֔ינוּ כְּדֶ֖רֶךְ כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Come, let us get our father drunk with wine so we can sleep with him and preserve his line.”
passages.sermon:
Lot was the father of two daughters.
The older daughter spoke to the younger daughter.
She said, “Let us give our father wine to drink.
Let us lie with him.
In this way, we will preserve our father’s family line.”
passages.original: לְכָ֨ה נַשְׁקֶ֧ה אֶת־ אָבִ֛ינוּ יַ֖יִן וְנִשְׁכְּבָ֣ה עִמּ֑וֹ וּנְחַיֶּ֥ה מֵאָבִ֖ינוּ זָֽרַע׃

passages.text: So that night they got their father drunk with wine, and the firstborn went in and slept with her father; he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up.
passages.sermon:
Lot was the father of two daughters.
That night, the two daughters gave their father wine to drink.
The older daughter went in to her father.
She lay with her father.
Lot did not know when his daughter lay down with him.
Lot did not know when his daughter got up.
passages.original: וַתַּשְׁקֶ֧יןָ אֶת־ אֲבִיהֶ֛ן יַ֖יִן בַּלַּ֣יְלָה ה֑וּא וַתָּבֹ֤א הַבְּכִירָה֙ וַתִּשְׁכַּ֣ב אֶת־ אָבִ֔יהָ וְלֹֽא־ יָדַ֥ע בְּשִׁכְבָ֖הּ וּבְקׄוּמָֽהּ׃

passages.text: The next day the older daughter said to the younger, “Look, I slept with my father last night. Let us get him drunk with wine again tonight so you can go in and sleep with him and we can preserve our father’s line.”
passages.sermon:
Lot was the father of two daughters.
The next day, the older daughter spoke to the younger daughter.
The older daughter said, “I slept with our father last night.
Let us give our father wine again tonight.
You go in and sleep with him.
We will preserve our father’s family line.”
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַתֹּ֤אמֶר הַבְּכִירָה֙ אֶל־ הַצְּעִירָ֔ה הֵן־ שָׁכַ֥בְתִּי אֶ֖מֶשׁ אֶת־ אָבִ֑י נַשְׁקֶ֨נּוּ יַ֜יִן גַּם־ הַלַּ֗יְלָה וּבֹ֙אִי֙ שִׁכְבִ֣י עִמּ֔וֹ וּנְחַיֶּ֥ה מֵאָבִ֖ינוּ זָֽרַע׃

passages.text: So again that night they got their father drunk with wine, and the younger daughter went in and slept with him; he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up.
passages.sermon:
Lot was the father of two daughters.
That night, the daughters gave their father wine to drink.
They made him drunk again.
The younger daughter got up.
She went in to her father.
She lay with him.
Lot did not know when she lay down.
Lot did not know when she got up.
passages.original: וַתַּשְׁקֶ֜יןָ גַּ֣ם בַּלַּ֧יְלָה הַה֛וּא אֶת־ אֲבִיהֶ֖ן יָ֑יִן וַתָּ֤קָם הַצְּעִירָה֙ וַתִּשְׁכַּ֣ב עִמּ֔וֹ וְלֹֽא־ יָדַ֥ע בְּשִׁכְבָ֖הּ וּבְקֻמָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Thus both of Lot’s daughters became pregnant by their father.
passages.sermon: Lot had two daughters.\r\nBoth daughters became pregnant.\r\nTheir father was the father of their children.
passages.original: וַֽתַּהֲרֶ֛יןָ שְׁתֵּ֥י בְנֽוֹת־ ל֖וֹט מֵאֲבִיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: The older daughter gave birth to a son and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites of today.
passages.sermon:
Lot had two daughters.
The older daughter gave birth to a son.
She named her son Moab.
Moab became the father of the Moabite people.
The Moabites are still known by this name today.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֤לֶד הַבְּכִירָה֙ בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ מוֹאָ֑ב ה֥וּא אֲבִֽי־ מוֹאָ֖ב עַד־ הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: The younger daughter also gave birth to a son, and she named him Ben-ammi. He is the father of the Ammonites of today.
passages.sermon:
Lot had two daughters.
The younger daughter gave birth to a son.
She named her son Ben-ammi.
Ben-ammi became the father of the Ammonites.
The Ammonites are his descendants today.
passages.original: וְהַצְּעִירָ֤ה גַם־ הִוא֙ יָ֣לְדָה בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בֶּן־ עַמִּ֑י ה֛וּא אֲבִ֥י בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֖וֹן עַד־ הַיּֽוֹם׃ס
